title: Sound Lab
mission: Build a visual analyzer for bundled synthetic audio samples.
steps: Add a sample chooser and explicit Start and Stop controls.
Read a bundled WAV sample and display its waveform.
Calculate and display a spectrum and peak frequency.
Provide numerical results and compare a tone, a mixture and silence.
checks: Known tones are identified within one frequency bin (sample rate / window size).
Silence produces finite values and a sensible no-peak message.
No playback or microphone access starts automatically; visual results are sufficient.
validation: Let users choose the analysis window and explain frequency resolution.
extension: Add smoothing or a frequency-band indicator. Microphone mode is optional and must release all tracks on Stop.
hint: Start by inspecting the WAV metadata and drawing a short waveform. Choose an analysis method before asking the agent to implement it.
